page.layout: One text column, with printed quotation marks („) at the left edge of the lines. No marginal notes. Printed page number top left. Running head at top, decorative type, illegible. Catchword "con-" at lower right, below the last line.

main_text.p: lecta, 40. D. de reb. cred. & item in L. Clodius, 97. de ac quir. heredit. Responsorum autem tantam uidemus au-ctoritatem fuisse, ut non modo in Iuris ciuilis parte uulgò in eo definiendo numerētur, uerùm etiam auctores ipsi Iuris conditores appellentur. Itaque Iustinianus in L. si furiosi, 25. C. de nupt. sic loquitur: Et quidem filiam fu-riosi marito posse copulari, omnes penè Iuris antiqui conditores admiserunt. Item Imperator Iulianus in L. nulla, 23. C. de procurat. Procurato[?] rem, inquit, posse eum insti-tuere ueteris Iuris uoluerūt

page.notes: The page opens mid-paragraph, so the first paragraph is a continuation. The running head is in ornamental type and could not be read. The printed quotation marks („) at the left are part of the text and are kept. "Procurato" at the line end is uncertain; the continuation "rem" is on the next line with no hyphen printed.
